release_date_policy: Use explicit authentic per-version launch dates when proved; otherwise maintain first-attestation date separately, with date_kind; YEAR OF SOURCE IS NOT CLAIMED FIRST HISTORICAL RELEASE YEAR
annual_progress_policy: Only mark a year SOURCE_BOUNDED_REVIEWED after official operator/version source census + pet evidence audit + residual list. Nothing is HISTORICALLY_COMPLETE without independent full historical proof. A year with 0 current records means NOT INVESTIGATED, not no pets.
region_version_policy: One chronological year spine, independent version lanes for each official operating region and product line, never substitute Taiwanese dates/client for mainland or Japan/Korea, never treat licensed mobile titles as same classic PC build.
late_discovery_policy: On new earlier evidence add a forward-only dated correction/backfill to that year's lane, keep old snapshot/pins, never append a 2001 pet as a 2026 release merely because discovered in 2026
count_policy: documentary release EVENT rows and original web positions/sprite groups are not global unique species. A region's marketing total of 200/229 is a milestone, not 229 independently verified names
